تستذنبي (form X)
# تَسْتَذْنِبِي (tastaḏnibī) /tas.tað.ni.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
# تُسْتَذْنَبِي (tustaḏnabī) /tus.tað.na.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
